description.value:
Requirements Your gear is overclocked.

You draw the magic out of your overclocked gear to power a spellshape. If your next action is to Cast a Spell, apply a single-action technomancer spellshape you know to that spell. The spell must meet any normal requirements of the spellshape. After this spell resolves, your gear is no longer overclocked, and your gear can't be overclocked again until your next turn.

Special If the spellshape you apply is the spellshape associated with your programming language, you can also apply one of your programming language's jailbreak effects to the spell.
